sourcedDescription: Raycash has not announced a token, a ticker, or an airdrop. Raycash Points are the only reward system so far, and the team has not said whether RP will convert into anything. That makes this a speculative airdrop built on early activity.
tagline_en: Raycash has not announced a token, a ticker, or an airdrop. Raycash Points are the only reward system so far, and the team has not said whether RP will convert into anything. That makes this a speculative airdrop built on early activity.

sourcedSteps.title: Join the Raycash Waitlist
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the Raycash waitlist and sign up with your email address.

sourcedSteps.title: Subscribe to the In Confidence Newsletter
sourcedSteps.body: Open the newsletter challenge on your dashboard and subscribe to In confidence, the Raycash newsletter for product news and insights. This adds another 100 RP.

sourcedSteps.title: Follow Raycash on X
sourcedSteps.body: Use the challenge card to follow @raycashxyz on X. The account posts product updates and beta announcements.

sourcedSteps.title: Post About Raycash on X
sourcedSteps.body: Complete the posting challenge by sharing a post about Raycash with your followers. Adding your referral link to the post lets any sign-ups from it count toward your referral points.

sourcedSteps.title: Join the Raycash Telegram Community
sourcedSteps.body: Join the Raycash Telegram through the challenge card to claim the last starter reward. The team posts releases there and answers questions from users.

sourcedSteps.title: Share Your Referral Link
sourcedSteps.body: Copy your personal referral link from the dashboard and send it to friends who might use a private stablecoin account. Each person who signs up through your link adds RP to your total.

sourcedSteps.title: Check for New Challenges and Beta Invites
sourcedSteps.body: Return to the dashboard regularly, since new challenges appear as the team adds them. Beta access rolls out in waves, so watch your inbox and the Raycash X account for your invite.
